'''Ojim Srellq''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who was a member of the [[Metatheran Cartel]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Circa [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], a number of Srellq's cargo shipments were stolen by the [[Rock Rogues]], a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] group that operated in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. In response, Srellq hired the [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Koll Jovas]] to find who had taken the cargo and recover the missing items.
